the pricing path changed: football/fbs/build_coverage.js -- coverage check 8 (FBS-vs-FCS stays on the slate) is proven against the feed instead of requiring one such game in the window; no projection, price or rating changes

the pricing path changed: football/cfb_p4/engine.js -- coverProbSpread re-centres the market-conditioned margin PMF by reweighting it in place instead of shifting it a whole number of points, so a tie (margin 0) keeps no mass and the key-number spikes stay on their margins (UConn @ Temple 2026-10-04: the shift put the 'no ties' hole on Temple -3). The fair spread, win probability, sigma and ratings are unchanged; cover and push probabilities move (the mean now lands exactly on the fair spread)

the pricing path changed: football/fbs/build_coverage.js -- the slate keeps the feed's start_time_tbd and season_type and labels every kickoff (kickoff_tbd, kickoff_state, kickoff_basis, game_date) and the artifact's current week through lib/edgedesk_schedule.js, so a placeholder midnight-Eastern time is never a confirmed kickoff (docs/system-integrity/AUDIT.md §2). No projection, price, rating or coverage rule changes

the research path changed: lib/edgedesk_canon.js, lib/cfb_terminal.js, lib/cfb_research_view.js -- display and classification consistency (docs/system-integrity): every model-market gap is computed from the two displayed lines under one rounding policy (lib/edgedesk_calc.js), so a research status at a threshold edge can move by at most 0.1 point to agree with the gap it prints; the engine's near-pick'em ±1 display floor is no longer a printed or compared number; projected scores are derived from the margin and total; quarterback wording follows lib/edgedesk_availability.js (a dropback split is a measured fact, a missing announcement is not uncertainty). No projection, fair line, win probability or threshold value changes

Is there a conference-specific residual bias?

triggers.question: Are verified major disagreements failing systematically?
triggers.threshold: n ≥ 20 settled verified and the market moved toward EdgeDesk < 50% of the time

triggers.question: Has probability calibration or interval coverage drifted?
triggers.threshold: last-100 win ECE > 0.06, or 80% coverage outside 75–85%

triggers.question: Has closing-line value deteriorated?
triggers.threshold: last-50 mean CLV < 0 by more than 2 SE, n ≥ 50

triggers.question: Is large rating-state divergence linked to model error (historical walk-forward)?
triggers.threshold: holdout LARGE − LOW MAE difference, and a football-only correction clearing the 0.05 bar
